seo.title: CEO Message - iVH
seo.description: A message from the CEO of iVH. Introducing the vision and values of iVH, a company specializing in simulation and mobility solutions.

ceo_contents: iVH is a premier solution provider dedicated to creating new value through innovative technology in a rapidly evolving industrial landscape. Leveraging our unparalleled expertise and technological prowess across Mobility, Energy, Smart Factory, and BEMS, iVH has consistently delivered optimized solutions to the real-world challenges faced by both industry and society.

Our pursuit of innovation always begins with "Technology for People." We believe that technology gains true meaning when interconnected and creates greater value when we grow together. By integrating extensive on-site industrial experience with proven processes based on international standards, iVH provides reliable solutions that unlock new possibilities for our clients.
Moving forward, iVH will continue to push the boundaries of challenge, focusing on three core strategic goals:

First, Securing leading-edge core technologies to spearhead the Mobility, Robotics, Energy, and Smart Factory sectors.
Second, Building highly scalable platforms that can be flexibly applied across diverse industrial fields.
Third, Realizing a healthy organizational culture where people and technology grow in harmony.
Through relentless innovation and growth, iVH is committed to being your most trusted and steadfast technology partner, shaping the future together.
ceo_footer:
Daeoh Kang
CEO, iVH Co., Ltd.
